message.marshlamp.lamp_full: This marsh lamp is already full
tooltip.marshlamp.bottled_wisp: Bottle a glowing marsh wisp flower. Use it on a lamp that is not full to charge it and get the bottle back.
tooltip.marshlamp.wisp_flower: Use a glass bottle while it is glowing. If the flower remains and the chunk stays loaded, it glows again in about %s seconds.
tooltip.marshlamp.sprout: Only a marsh lamp can grow it. Right-click when ripe to harvest marsh sprout wheat.
tooltip.marshlamp.tool: Mines faster while the wick is lit. Right-click a marsh lamp to refuel.
tooltip.marshlamp.hoe: Right-click a crop to age it for 5 wick.
tooltip.marshlamp.lantern: Hold it in either hand to light the way. It spends brightness over time. Right-click a marsh lamp to refuel.
